Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-03
DOC-0018 2026-05-22
SHIFT NOTES — Electrical Questions Parked for the
Morning Sweep
Date: 2026-05-22
Station: DEMO-STATION-03
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
07:40 — PERSON-0021 prepares the electrical desk papers for
TEAM-0003. Use ISSUE-0062 with TASK-0161 and TASK-0162 as the
locating references for the discussion folder. Keep desk
requests requiring an immediate destination on the front
clipboard.
08:00 — Put longer scheduling questions in the question
ledger. Each entry needs the exact question, intended
addressee, and promised reply date. The ledger belongs to
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA's desk routine and must travel with the
questions, not remain in the outgoing coordinator's notebook.
08:35 — Park the electrical backlog discussion under the sweep
divider for the Friday queue sweep at 09:10. Ask the chair to
arrange the next owner conversation and a date for gathering
any missing papers. Parking is a meeting arrangement; it must
not be copied into a record category.
09:40 — Bring the divider back to the electrical desk after
the sweep. Attach the chair's action list beside the original
questions, retaining any reason for postponing a discussion.
The incoming coordinator needs the unanswered question as well
as the appointment.
Next-shift list
- Match the returned action list to the ledger entries.
~ Keep immediate desk requests outside the sweep divider.
- Confirm the next promised reply date with each receiving
role before shelving the electrical folder.
D. Worker 0027
Demo Worker 0021, Demo Team 03
Page 1 of 1
